notes.title: Devlog #11 - Coalitions
notes.content:
In this devlog we will look more in depth at how our main short term progression system works.  

Throughout the game, players encounter "Power Ups" that enhance their character's skillset with new abilities and opportunities. In UMC, these are known as "Aspects"; thematically, each Aspect belongs to a group called a "Coalition," named after different species of wild cats. Currently, we are introducing three Coalitions:

[list]
[*] Cheetah (Speed, Lightning)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/c320243c6b4fa1051384dc336ab8c85d2d1cc544.png[/img]
[*] Jaguar (Critical, Dodge)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/bb1154a29661dda8f67fa66c7ee7c56f5b7a9fb4.png[/img]
[*] Tiger (Damage, Bleed)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/c1f6a1ed9754d148a5ae5e4c97f11408aef4bc89.png[/img]
[/list]
Each Coalition loosely adheres to the nature of its namesake cat and introduces corresponding effects to enhance this fantasy (indicated in brackets next to the Coalition names).

Aspects come in three rarity levels (Common, Rare, Epic). Each increase in rarity unlocks additional effects that the upgrade can activate (up to 2 additional effects at Epic rarity). The rarity levels are as follows:

Additionally, each Aspect has up to three ranks, with each rank providing higher numerical values for the unlocked Aspect effect. For example:

[list]
[*] Rank 1 - Primary attack deals 5 damage
[*] Rank 2 - Primary attack deals 10 damage
[*] Rank 3 - Primary attack deals 15 damage
[/list]

This approach gives another little dimension to the Aspects' progression and extends it slightly to have more variation. 

Aspects in a single Coalition are divided into three categories:
[list]
[*] Slotted Aspects
[*] Passive Aspects
[*] Ultra Aspects
[/list]

[b]Slotted Aspects[/b]
These can be “inserted” into the range of “slots” tied to the different actions that players can take during the playthrough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/3d47f1a4a2d1820fd9fbd42e181b4330eb74d3c8.png[/img]

[b]The list of slots is as follows:[/b]

[list]
[*] On Primary Attack - the applied upgrade activates its effect while using Primary Attack.
[*] On Secondary Attack - the applied upgrade activates its effect while using Secondary Attack. 
[*] On Ability Used - the applied upgrade activates its effect while using any Ability.
[*] Banner Aura - Upon killing the first enemy in any given room, Banner is spawned, which provides passive benefits to everyone in its radius.
[*] On Critical Hit - the applied upgrade activates its effect while Critical Hit is executed on an enemy.
[/list]

[b]Passive Aspects[/b]
Passive Aspects are what the name implies - passive bonuses that are always active and don’t occupy any particular slot. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/8c70b4d0ce9ca023479c2db37d7667e160a0db34.png[/img]

[b]Ultra Aspects[/b]
Ultra Aspects are another type of passive ability that is scarce and powerful. Since their power is usually game-changing, they are limited to a maximum of 2 per run, and at the moment, they can’t be replaced.

To give some context - here are some Tiger Aspects you can choose to use : . 

On Primary Attack -  [b]Aftermath [/b]- Your Primary attacks have 10% chance to inflict Bleed status.   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/1559a732cec4d830c44f95ec81f5dfcac82dc75c.png[/img]

On Secondary Attack - [b]Tiger’s Revenge[/b] - Your secondary attacks deal 15% of enemy missing HP as extra damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/ee20ba72b8149859ab39c0283e12c8a40d1aea76.png[/img]

On Ability Cast - [b]Scorched Earth[/b] - After Using ability you get you 5% dmg bonus for 5s
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/335fee8d55cd1791c84964dd192310e8049288b9.png[/img]

Banner Aura - [b]Banner of Fury[/b] - Spawn a Banner in the spot of first killed enemy in each room that grants 5% additional Base Damage to eveoryone in radius of (16) meters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/09fad3ecc373534a1b4b011ea6f28cd81ef5cb7c.png[/img]

On Critical Attack -[b]Ring of Blood[/b] -  Your Critical Hit has 30% more chance to inflict Bleed status.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/462a753d94897ab54426444e293277b5b3c8da55.png[/img]

Passive - [b]Fangs of Flame[/b] - All your attacks create small explosion dealing 30% splash damage to every enemy within 5 meter radius.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/2a189c49bf80aa6f710ef2eac45417e397a7c2ff.png[/img]

Ultra - [b]Welcome to the Jungle[/b] - If there are more than 4 enemies nearby your damage is increased by 175%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/f16823f497fa78f8bef923a5dae8b93e64d1d243.png[/img]


Stay sharp. Stay fluffy.

notes.title: Devlog #10 - M.O.Ds are here
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hi everyone! 🐈[/b][/h3]

🐾[b]In UMC, we have two types of progression - short and long progression to ensure players' engagement on all layers of fluffy accomplishment. 🎯

Today we will look into main long term progression system which we call M.O.D[/b]🛠️

🔧 This acronym translates into “Mythical Optimization Device.” M.O.Ds are the most endgame-oriented pieces of progression, allowing players to alter and customize every ability of every character in the game. 

Each character's ability has three slots ready to be populated with M.O.Ds. Based on the slot takeup of the M.O.D rarity, the player can mix and match different combinations to adjust the ability workings to his liking. This flexible approach doesn’t imply that the Legendary M.O.Ds will be the strongest. Of course, Legendary ones will significantly impact how the ability behaves. Still, there may be occasions where Epic + Rare combo will be more suitable for some, and it’s up to the players to decide.

So let’s take a look into some of the most fun MODs our feline heroes can unlock and use to bring a lot of mayhem into your runs. 

[previewyoutube=PmvwJdbnOxM;full][/previewyoutube]

🗡️  [b]Kagero’s Katana Slash[/b] ability ability can be upgraded for example with 
[i]Hyperstep Inscription[/i] - this [b]Rare MOD[/b] makes taking care of enemies with Katana even more deadly and fun as it recovers [b]Kagero’s Dash[/b] ability instantly after using Katana Slash. It enables to instantly move from one enemy to another before they realise what hit them. ⚡

 🔫 [b]BBKAT[/b] main weapon is Machine Gun and it’s a lot of fun. But my acquiring [i]Mighty Rocket Gun[/i] [b]Legendary MOD[/b] you can ramp up the fun even more. Why shoot with Bullets if you can shoot with Rockets ? Mighty Rocket Gun reduces recoil and fire rate of Machine Gun but it shoots rockets instead that deal Direct and [b]Splash damage[/b]. 

🎯 [b]Clint [/b]is gunslinger supreme but you can choose to make him even more supreme with [i]Deadeye Focus[/i] which Increases the damage of the last bullet in each revolver’s chamber, encouraging [b]precise, deliberate shots[/b].

But those are only examples and tip of an iceberg. Each hero will have 35 different MODS that you unlock to find your favorite combinations. 


Stay sharp. Stay fluffy.
– The Ultra Mega Cats Dev Team 🐾💫

notes.title: Devlog #9 - Co-op explained
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/e5a8a0ecf1f07a71596dd3af99e95d139affad9d.png[/img]

[h3]Hey Catventurers! 🐱💥[/h3]

We know many of you might enjoy taking on Ultra Mega Cats solo — customizing your heroes, unlocking new Coalitions, and discovering powerful builds. And yes, the game is absolutely playable and enjoyable in single-player mode.

But today, we want to spotlight the fur-ocious fun of co-op gameplay. Because sometimes, the only thing better than saving the world as a Mega Cat… is doing it with friends.

[previewyoutube=baI0SKirigw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Up to 3 Players Online Co-op[/b][/h3]
Grab up to two friends and dive into chaotic, cat-fueled action together! Every session supports up to three players. Whether you're coordinating strategies or just unleashing mayhem, co-op adds a whole new layer of excitement (and yarnballs) to every run.

[h3][b]🧪 Mix and Match Your Squad[/b][/h3]
Want to run a trio of BB-Kats? Go for it. Three Clints? Why not. Any combination of characters is fair game — experiment with your favorite setups and discover unexpected synergies between your feline fighters.

[h3][b]🧠 Team-Based Tactics (and Shenanigans)[/b][/h3]
Our heroes have abilities that complement each other beautifully in co-op. A few examples:

Shielded Stealth: Hide Kagero behind BB-Kat’s sturdy shield, letting her strike safely from the shadows.

Focus Fire Bait: Let Clint soak up enemy attention while BB-Kat unleashes Yarnball chaos from the flank.

These are just a taste — Ultra Mega Cats is full of creative combos waiting to be discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/0e023f7d443ee681ec0c878e39981c7306bf8d53.png[/img]

[h3][b]🐾 Coalitions That Shine in Co-op[/b][/h3]
Coalitions are a key part of progression in Ultra Mega Cats, and some shine even brighter with a full team. Check out these co-op-ready Coalition abilities:

[b]Cheetah’s Aura of Grace[/b]
Deploys a banner with a speed-boosting aura. The higher the rarity, the bigger the boost — and it affects your whole team.

[b]Jaguar’s Paws of Rage[/b]
With epic rarity, this skill spawns milk bottles that any friendly cat can grab. Collect one, and you reset all cooldowns for everyone.

[b]Tiger’s Ring of Blood[/b]
Bleed your enemies en masse with one cat, then tag in a teammate to finish them off in a frenzy of claws and coordination.

[h3][b]🧩 The Combo Potential is Off the Charts[/b][/h3]
Beyond Hero skills and Coalition powers, there are MODS, vending machine upgrades, and more — all of which can be shared or synergized in co-op runs. And remember: the more cats in the fight, the tougher the enemies become. So teamwork (and clever builds) are key!

Whether you're a lone cat warrior or part of a synchronized squad of furballs, we can’t wait to see the wild strategies and hilarious moments you’ll come up with.

[h3][b]🎨 New Arts on Steam![/b][/h3]

Oh, and have you noticed? We've just updated all the art on our Steam main page! Check it out and let us know what you think of the fresh look. Your feedback means the world to us!


Stay sharp. Stay fluffy.
– The Ultra Mega Cats Dev Team 🐾

notes.title: Devlog #8 - Rabbit Shooter
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone! 💥[/h3]

We’ve been teasing some big trouble coming to Machineland, and it's finally time to reveal the newest threat our feline heroes will face. Say hello (but maybe don’t get too close) to the Rabbit Shooters – the iron-fisted enforcers of Theodore’s army!

These mechanical monsters are more than just big bunnies with bad attitudes. They’re the muscle guarding the deadliest corners of Machineland, and they’re ready to stomp, shoot, and blast anything that crosses their path... including you. 😼💣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/db7a1a226b5424fd5511d68cf5995099e79e1fc7.jpg[/img]

Are our Cats ready to take them on? Here's a breakdown of what they’ll be up against:

[h3]🧨 Shooting Barrage – Duck and Weave, or Get Wrecked![/h3]

The Rabbit Shooter takes a knee and locks in with deadly precision. Then—bam bam bam—he fires 7 consecutive projectiles from his massive arm cannon. Each shot packs serious heat, so dodging is crucial!

[b]⚠️ Pro tip: [/b]Wait for the reload! Once he's out of ammo, he’s vulnerable for a few seconds while he reloads. That’s your window to strike.

[h3]🦿 Heavy Stomp – Watch the Ground![/h3]

The Rabbit charges up his hydraulic legs and launches into a mechanical leap. When he lands—BOOM—a shockwave ripples out and deals area damage.

💥 Stay mobile, keep your eyes on his trajectory, and jump out of that danger zone before your whiskers get singed!

[h3]💣 Detonating Paws – Rocket Rain Incoming![/h3]

In his most devastating attack yet, the Rabbit Shooter raises a paw to the sky and unleashes a flurry of rockets. Each missile locks onto your location, landing with a marked warning spot before impact.

🔥 Each blast deals both direct and splash damage, so even near-misses can hurt. Use your reflexes

[previewyoutube=oJVnMSHXusE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🐾 Are Your Cats Ready?[/h3]

Facing a Rabbit Shooter will be a test of reflexes, timing, and teamwork. These encounters are meant to push your skills to the limit and reward those who fight smart — not just fast.

We'll be watching closely to see how you all handle these fluffy behemoths. And who knows... maybe a few secrets are hidden behind their steel-plated armor. 👀

Stay sharp out there, and as always —

[b]Scratch back hard, Cats. 🐾[/b]

— The Dev Team 💙

notes.title: Devlog #6 - THE LEGEND OF CAT PARADISE
notes.content:
Kagero sheathed her katana at her side and took a deep breath. The bodies of defeated
enemies lay strewn around her - she was seldom impressed by numerical superiority. 

[b]"[i]The lion does not fear to walk alone among the sheep.[/i]"[/b]

A series of explosions followed by joyful, childish laughter echoed from deep within the
massive production hall, reassuring Kagero that her companion also had no major problems
with facing an entire enemy squad on his own. Nevertheless, she advanced toward him - he
had to be protected; after all, he was still just a child.

When Kagero located Baby Cat, the battle had already concluded. However, the kitten
continued to maneuver his giant combat mech around, firing rockets at any piece of the
environment that seemed insufficiently damaged. With a spray of bullets from his machine
gun, he had etched the shapes of butterflies and smiley faces into the walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/e4acd5abfc577a09783c2d378144c02940292993.png[/img]

- [b]“[i]Enough, little one,[/i]”[/b] the assassin murmured, jumping onto the mech. 

- [b]“[i]Do you understand why we're doing this? Why do we fight?[/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]For fun![/i]”[/b] Baby Cat squealed with delight, his answer to every question always the same.

- [b]“[i]It’s more than fun. Let me tell you.[/i]”[/b]

Kagero signaled for the little one to open the cockpit hatch and then perched herself on one of the robot's mechanical arms.

- [b]“[i]We cats are not like other animals,[/i]”[/b] she began. [b]“[i]We don’t hail from this world. Long ago, we had a paradise of our own—a cat paradise.[/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]What's paradise?[/i]”[/b] Baby Cat asked, furrowing his brow.

- [b]“[i]A place of harmony. True harmony, whose goal isn't to balance opposites but to break free from their eternal dance. It's an indivisible and omnipresent unity that...[/i]”[/b]

Large, shiny eyes gazed up at her, filled with unwavering incomprehension.

- [b]“[i]Still too young for philosophy, huh?[/i]”[/b] she sighed. [b]“[i]Very well. Picture a realm where there's
no death, no worries. Even better! No standing water to drink. Rather, a place abundant with
everything delightful.[/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]Exlplosions![/i]”[/b] the little kitten exclaimed. [b]“[i]Boomies are the bestest![/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]And what if I told you about food that is always fresh, moist, and perfectly in the middle of
a bowl so wide that its edges never ever touch your whiskers? A private beam of afternoon
sun for anyone who wants a nap?[/i]”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/8e3970862d09c9187f3a0051e01506955fc02a76.png[/img]

- [b]“[i]I don’t wanna sleeeep[/i]”[/b] Baby Cat whined, his mouth pouting into a sad horseshoe shape. [b]“[i]I want booooms![/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]Hmm, let me think... Sometimes, stars would break away from the night sky and fall to the
ground, glowing red-hot. They would bounce all around the land like mad. Catching one of
the Red Dots was a real feat! I guess shooting it down would count, too. As a reward, you’d
get a wreath made of fresh catnip...[/i]”[/b] the assassin daydreamed so heavily that her pupils
dilated. [b]“[i]Ah, to get high once again... up there, to heaven, I mean![/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]What's get high mean?[/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]I'll tell you when you're older.[/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]But...[/i]”[/b]

Suddenly, Kagero's ears turned like satellites towards a dark corridor leading deeper into the
factory.

- [b]“[i]Never mind,[/i]”[/b] she cut him off. [b]“[i]It seems the wind is about to bring another storm.[/i]”[/b]
[hr][/hr]

The enemy's greatest strength lay in their number. Mechanized rodents didn't pose much of a
threat individually, but now they pressed from all sides, and for every fallen soldier, two more
appeared. 

Baby Cat was in his element: he launched rockets left and right, laughing out loud
when the enemy projectiles bounced off his mech’s protective field like mere pebbles. But the
pebbles kept coming, more and more of them.

- [b]“[i]More story![/i]”[/b] the kitten called out, utterly oblivious to the gravity of their predicament.
[b]“[i]About the cool paradise![/i]”[/b]

- [b]“[i]Now?[/i]”[/b] Kagero gasped, dodging an enemy strike.

- [b]“[i]I’m bored![/i]”[/b]

Once again, raising the little kitten proved to be a challenge greater than any battle.

[b]“[i]Well...[/i]”[/b] the cat started but halted abruptly, vanishing into the shadows and reappearing
moments later in a wholly different spot, where she swiftly neutralized a laser turret. 

[b]“[i]In our paradise, there were boxes. Countless cardboard boxes of every size! And each one was
empty, just perfect for...[/i]”[/b]

[b]“[i]For shoots! Rat-tat-tat! Pew pew![/i]”[/b] Baby Cat illustrated his point with a real burst from his
machine gun. A few enemies fell.

[b]“[i]It would be a waste of perfectly good boxes... but you could shoot at yarn balls! In paradise,
there were whole herds of rolling yarn balls.[/i]”[/b]

[b]“[i]I likes yarn. Yarns go whoosh![/i]”[/b] the kitten rejoiced. Unnoticed by him, the energy level
powering Baby Cat’s mech's shields had plummeted to a critical low.

Suddenly, the radio connection between the cats became fractured and filled with static. From
a distance, Kagero could only see Baby Cat's robot forming into a ball and disappearing into
a swarm of charging enemies.

[b]“[i]Little one![/i]”[/b] she cried out, dashing toward him.
[b]“[i]And wha- do you lik- in pa- dise?[/i]”[/b]

Kagero slashed with her katana in a frenzy, completely forgetting her training and discipline.
Her stamina was diminishing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/5bd34460acbd025cc2fb115f447626c0c46b47db.png[/img]

[b]“[i]Tel...l me.[/i]”[/b]

Then the comms channel got silent, and the weirdest thing happened. The assassin couldn't
tell if it was sheer exhaustion or fleeting glimpses of the fabled cat paradise blurring her
vision, but instead of a rodent army, she now saw scores of adorable plush mice before her.
And Kagero secretly loved everything sweet and cute - so much that she couldn't bear it and
would often give up to an urge to tear the object into pieces.

[b]“[i]Kawaii![/i]”[/b] she squealed, overcome with lust for murder.

After a few moments of pure fury, the enemy unit eased to exist. Kagero, breathing heavily,
reached the mech, still coiled on the ground.

[b]“[i]Little one! What's with you? Answer![/i]”[/b] She pounded on the impassive metal shell. [b]“[i]You
can't... Speak up... Please...[/i]”[/b]

As if on cue, the robot unfolded. The kitten sat behind the controls - unscratched, perfectly
fine, and very pleased with himself.

[b]“[i]Supper Baby Cat reporting for duty![/i]”[/b] he shouted, saluting crookedly.

Kagero was still in shock. But she didn't have a moment to gather her thoughts and calm her
racing heart - like children of all species, Baby Cat had no mercy for adult concerns.

[b]“[i]More story, please?[/i]”[/b] he pleaded.
[b]“[i]Do I even have a choice?[/i]”[/b] she sighed, her exhalation heavy with resignation. [b]“[i]Alright,
listen. The paradise was tended by the almighty Ancient Cats - our gods...[/i]”[/b]

[b]“[i]Ourgods...[/i]”[/b] the little one echoed, his eyes wide with fascination for all things grand and
powerful.

Kagero shared with Baby Cat all she knew about the Ancient Cats. How they were born from
chaos and possessed great power, each embodying a chosen aspect of feline power. About
their divine abode, the Sacred Scratcher, a towering construction full of houses, platforms,
and shelves, one for each Ancient Cat. And about the day when it all came to an end.

[b]“[i]Other animals learned about our paradise and went mad with envy. They couldn't stand our
happiness.[/i]”[/b] Kagero said, her voice tinged with resentment. 

[b]“[i]So they broke in, toppled theSacred Scratcher, and destroyed everything. The cats were either taken captive or forced to hide in other worlds. Over time, they forgot about the lost paradise; some even forgot how to speak! Can you imagine? But deep down, they all long for it. That's why every cat still wants a miniature Sacred Scratcher at home, even if they don't remember its divine origins. And when sometimes they stare off at presumably nothing? That's when they’re trying to piece together the elusive memories of it all.[/i]”[/b]

[b]“[i]And Ourgods?[/i]”[/b] Baby Cat asked.

Kagero's gaze wandered through the wreckage of the hall to the next part of the factory,
where their mission objective awaited. She rose to her feet and headed in that direction.

[b]“[i]Well, about that...[/i]”[/b] she said, smiling. [b]“[i]Get up, Little One! We have a god to liberate.[/i]”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/8e3970862d09c9187f3a0051e01506955fc02a76.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #5 - Together For Cats!
notes.content:
[h2]Virtual cats in our game can fight for themselves, but real cats often need help.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/57023fad78859f1ecb28aae0cd54aa9d69a71530.png[/img]
At Fallen Leaf, we have not only people who work on video games but also cat lovers. During the planning stage for our next game, many team members mentioned wanting to create a game where the main characters are these adorable animals. That's how the idea for Ultra Mega Cats came about.

Creating the game is one thing, but we also want to use our work to do something beneficial for real cats, who face various issues such as illness, hunger, and abandonment. We know people who are addressing these problems, and we would like to join their efforts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/bafb62385365ae693cdf1550f31525929b4e6415.png[/img]

In our country, there are cafes that, in addition to serving coffee (and other treats), also take care of cats. They do this in various ways: feeding, sheltering abandoned animals, providing medical care, or assisting with adoptions. These are places where people can enjoy the company of cats while drinking their coffee and offer help if they wish.

We found several places to which we gave gadgets related to our game, so they could distribute them among their customers and encourage support for these places. If you are in Poland, it's worth dropping by for a coffee with our friends:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/kotkacafe]Kotka Cafe[/url] - Gdańsk
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100083682233714]Niebieski Kot[/url] - Opole
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/kociecafe]Kocie Cafe[/url] - Białystok
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/0b08d34367b9ff96214e12114b6c4f2f202171c5.png[/img]
However, we wanted to do more while creating Ultra Mega Cats, so we came up with the idea of a charity stream. As the game's creators, we would encourage support for the "Puszatek" foundation by giving away copies of our game to viewers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/b09c0ca1c70ae156da195d546359884e0ce8f65d.png[/img]

"Puszatek" is an amazing foundation that collaborates with over a hundred shelters across Poland. Their efforts cover practically everything: supporting shelters in improving conditions for the cats, organizing food and material drives, and encouraging people to adopt cats.

We are eager to help the foundation and thought that raising awareness about their work and gathering funds for their beneficiaries would be incredibly helpful. We are in contact with Puszatek and will provide more details soon.

If you want to learn more about them, be sure to check out their website: [url=https://puszatek.pl/]Puszatek[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #4 - The demo has arrived!
notes.content:
[h2]It’s DEMOlition time![/h2]

Who let the cats out?! We did! It’s time to change theory into practice! Today we are ultra-mega excited to show you the effects of our work with the [b]Ultra Mega Cats demo, which is live NOW![/b] Before you go all in, let’s take a minute to prepare for wreaking furrious havoc and read what awaits you inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/b1a991b7c204856d4bcd05f0c7e53b213b5c6541.gif[/img]
[h2]The demo contents[/h2]

You can play the demo solo or invite a friend to spread mayhem together in a 2-player co-op mode. There are two pawesome characters for you to control, grow overpowered, and try to complete a test run in our first biome, Machineland (you can read more about it here). The demo version of Machineland consists of five rooms, swarming with enemies, and a final fight with one of our dreadful bosses - the disturbing Rat King. 

Please note that the demo could be challenging (especially playing solo) but we will tweak the game's difficulty based on your feedback. 

[h2]Meet the heroes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/c14fdd415acd1c162d6dea1073701a6372b25cea.png[/img]
[b]KAGERO[/b] is the deadliest assassin among all cats. She is a fast-moving, elusive bow-shooting and katana-wielding ninja, whose body has been enhanced with advanced cyber implants. The purrfect [b]damage dealer[/b]! You can learn Kagero’s backstory in her reveal trailer.

[b]Kagero skillset breakdown:[/b]

[b]Passive[/b]
Clawdacity: Fury-like energy meter. Killing enemies and receiving damage generates this resource. Once full, Kagero can enter Moewverdive, which boosts all stats.

[b]Primary[/b]
Kinetic Bow: Shoots an arrow from the bow. The longer you hold a button, the farther the arrow flies and the more damage it deals.

[b]Secondary[/b]
Slash: Kagero dashes forward, attacking enemies, with Katana dealing small amounts of damage to everyone on her way and dealing more damage to enemies in front of her.

[b]Special[/b]
Stealth: Kagero becomes invisible and leaves a few spikes behind that can damage enemies. Each second, you regenerate a small amount of Health.

[b]Defensive[/b]
Dash: Dashes in the direction of movement, dodging all incoming damage.

[b]Utility[/b]
Meowverdrive: Kagero enters an overcharged state, granting her more movement speed, damage, incoming damage reduction, and cooldown reduction. Upon activation, it also resets all ongoing cooldowns. It can be activated only when the Clawdacity meter is full and, once activated, cannot be stopped or canceled. The Clawdacity meter is set to zero upon activation and doesn't regenerate until Moewverdrive is over.

[b]Move Ability[/b]
Double Jump: Kagero can jump a second time while in mid-air. This second jump can be performed before landing and is only 50% as high as the main one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/94e94c9338f319c47c05cb5bb0154c0e2d22e20c.jpg[/img]
[b]BBkat[/b] is our second hero. Don’t get fooled by his cute, innocent looks - he is the demolition kitten! He loves to play, especially the game called “wreaking havoc with flurries of rockets and machine gunfire while staying perfectly safe inside my heavily armored battle mech”. As a tank, he can take a lot of damage and won’t even notice!

[b]BBKat skillset breakdown:[/b]

[b]Passive[/b]
Fortification: Have an additional Shield attribute that protects Baby Cat from incoming damage. Once depleted, the regular Health pool is exposed to attacks.

[b]Primary[/b]
Machine gun: Automatic heat-based weapon. Shooting generates heat; once it reaches the threshold, the weapon is unusable for a short period and needs to cool down.

[b]Secondary[/b]
Rocket Launcher: Launches a rocket that detonates on contact with an enemy.

[b]Special[/b]
Snare Field: Deploys a field of mouse traps around the character. Once the enemy comes close, it clamps on him, dealing damage and rooting for a short duration.

[b]Defensive[/b]
Purr-tection Shield: Creates a holographic barrier in front of Baby Cat and sends it forward. The shield blocks all projectiles and enemies. It has its health pool - once depleted, the shield is destroyed.

[b]Utility[/b]
Roll: Transforms you into a ball for a short time. While in a ball form, it regenerates your shield, taunts all nearby enemies, and nullifies incoming damage, but your speed is greatly reduced. Using this ability a second time cancels it, and the cooldown is applied.

[b]Move  Ability[/b]
Jetpack: Soar in the air and smash the enemies from above for as long as the fuel lasts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/eb27801f1b75856b392a0170c51f958b62cd2c04.png[/img]
[h2]Progress to the ultra-mega level[/h2]

Remember our Aspect System, the way for our Ultra Mega Cats to practically ascend to godhood? You’ll test it on the run! In the demo, two powerful Cat Gods will lend you their powers: Cheetah, the Incarnate of Swiftness, and Jaguar, the Incarnate of Stealth. That means you’ll get critically dangerous and quick! Let’s learn a bit more about the Aspects. They are divided into three groups:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/18cc13be67177d08226fe36b5b245df0c3991457.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Slotted Aspects can be inserted into predefined slots, one at a time. Upon encountering an Aspect that would go into an occupied slot, the player can swap the old one with the new one. If the chosen Aspect swapped another one in an already occupied slot, its level would be one higher than initially.

[*] Passive Aspects are always active and don’t occupy any particular slot. There are no limits (at the moment) on how many passive abilities you can have. Their power is rather subtle, but boy, can they stack!

[*] Ultra Aspects are passive, too but as scarce as they are powerful. Since their power is usually game-changing, they are limited to a maximum of 2 per run, and at the moment, they can’t be replaced.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/079e42899e0932b6b9db1c03050adc7cba32da56.png[/img]

Besides the Coalition Chests with the Aspects inside, upon finishing a room you will also find the Power-Up Chests with more typical rewards, such as shop discounts, HP restoration, Aspects alterations, and various upgrades.

Finally, we will give you a taste of the long progression system, a way to upgrade your Cats not just for the duration of the run, but permanently. In the demo, Kagero and Baby Cat have been pre-equipped with some starting M.O.D.S. that influence their play style. In the full version of Ultra Mega Cats, you will be able to change the M.O.D.S. and get even more absurdly and diversly overpowered!

[h2]Controls[/h2]

We want you to quickly achieve mastery in controlling your cats, so we've prepared control schemes for you. Thanks to this, you'll be able to handle arenas without any problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/b060713cdb766c719309a20ddb05cace84eadaf7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/8bcb1eab1831b2aed0a43bcc36a31b10c586a9f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/eeba0625b0af2d8b428fa6b265b2a637a344ad0d.png[/img]

[h2]Feedback is king[/h2]

Enough talking, let’s start playing! We hope you’ll have a great time in the Ultra Mega Cats demo and can’t wait to hear from you. Was it pawesome? Or is there room for improvement? Your feedback is crucial. Share your thoughts on the Steam Community Page or our [url=https://discord.gg/KBHpb6js5J]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
[b]Fur, spice, and everything nice… Those were the ingredients chosen to create the
perfect little kitten. But at Unseen Silence, we also totally deliberately added an
extra ingredient to the concoction—absurd amounts of power! Thus, the Ultra
Mega Cats were born, and today, we will take a closer look at their ultra-mega powers
and the gameplay they constitute.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/1cb552d44b2a9a45158c59d38b3d582d0d5da8d8.png[/img]

[b]CATS, BUT MAKE THEM OVERPOWERED[/b]

For the common house cat, spreading mayhem and destruction is simply inherent. It
is not a bug, it is a feature. To bring it to the ultra-mega level, you need some
additional steps:
[list]
[*] Endow each cat with a unique set of combat and movement abilities
[*] Let them make progress, evolve, and upgrade themselves in a variety of ways
[*] Put them in some extremely able hands (Yeah, that’s you! Right?)
[/list]
Then, apply the cherry on top—the Aspects System, our secret ingredient that makes
the Ultra Mega Cats truly overpowered and keeps the game ever-fresh and exciting
each run. But first… let’s pay a due tribute to the gods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/eb27801f1b75856b392a0170c51f958b62cd2c04.png[/img]

[b]THE ANCIENT CATS, GODS OF FELINES[/b]

It is said that in the beginning, there was chaos. But chaos, like a knocked-over fern
or a broken mug, doesn’t create itself. Indeed, all evidence points out that in the
beginning, there had to be cats. The Ancient Cats, beings embodying the greatest
features of the felines.
[list]
[*] Cheetah, the Incarnate of Swiftness
[*] Jaguar, the Incarnate of Stealth
[*] Lion, the Incarnate of Strength
[*] Tiger, the Incarnate of Fury
[*] [The Mysterious Fifth Cat]
[/list]
The gods created the cat race in their image and likeness and made a heaven for
them to live in. The Ancient Cats could also bless the regular cats with their powers,
making them their champions. The Ultra Mega Cats. You can already see where this
is going, right?

After the terrible attack of other animals, some of the feline gods got imprisoned,
and the regular cats were enslaved. It is now the quest of a few remaining cats to
fight for their freedom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/64c4ebb8a60f40e2ab22b45a56aa0286b22e8d6e.gif[/img]

[b]IT’S SUPER EFFECTIVE! THE ASPECTS SYSTEM[/b]

The Aspects are the temporary gods' blessings. Boons, that fill your cat with divine powers to help them get through the dynamically generated rooms that build a biome. They are designed to bring different kinds of overpower to life and support the playstyle that fits you best. Because the Aspects only last for the duration of the run, each game becomes a new experience, garnished with just the right amount of exciting randomness we all love. 🎰

During the run, you will encounter many opportunities to empower your cat's skillset with new skills and possibilities. The Aspects would be found in the Coalition Chests - the Coalition is a family of Aspects coming from the same Ancient Cat and named after them. Each Coalition consists of 10 Aspects with 3 different rarity levels. What’s more, each Aspect can be further upgraded, creating tons of opportunities and options to tinker with. Just pick and mix the Coalitions however you like, and combine the Aspects into amazing builds! 

[b]Here’s a sneak peek at some of the Aspects we’ve prepared:[/b]

[b]Electricheetah[/b] buffs Primary attacks with a chance to emit Lighting Bolts! You can truly transform your cat into a God of Thunder and Rock N Roll.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/4b90400f98db5457ecd819e01ba90d71fbed634c.gif[/img]

[b]Call of The Wind[/b] is the Ancient Jaguar’s Banner Aura which spawns a Banner in the spot of the first defeated enemy in each room that grants an amazing Dodge Bonus to every friendly character in a 20m radius.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/7fa1a50643a8e670013eade88533a89b3b27de25.gif[/img]

[b]Paws of Rage[/b] on the other hand (or paw) not only gives Primary attacks extra Critical Chance, but also grants a chance to spawn Milk Bottles. What did you expect, nectar? It’s feline gods! Milk Bottles provide a powerful bonus of resetting all cooldowns for friendly characters. Refreshing!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/081437d71cfc123357a9c89ca1887bb8bb391273.gif[/img]

As you progress through the biomes and free more Ancient Cats, new sets of Aspects become available. It means more unique builds and even more ways of having fun to discover!

[b]How do you like our Aspects System? Will you devote yourself to one Coalition and turn its powers up to absurd levels or create a dangerous mix of few? Or maybe you will be lucky enough to find the rare and legendary versions? We can’t wait for your creativity to break in! 🤯 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/4bdf6dc2c187f10b69fedd58a75c47f113043f69.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Have you ever heard that nobody is perfect? Scientific evidence from the Biolab says otherwise! The Biolab is an experimental compound swarming with reptiles and amphibians surgically brought to perfection. So pay attention, Cats, because bringing your A-game would be the bare minimum for survival. To succeed? Let’s just say it will have something to do with defeating the conjoined power of both ROBOTS and DINOSAURS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/b176ab9702df29fcb922e53df0e6ed9ad55394a1.png[/img]

[h3]CENTER OF APPLIED PERFECTION: BIOLAB[/h3]

The Biolab mission is to bring every animal to its perfect form - at least, that is what the leaflet says. It’s partially true! Wingstitch Spitfire, Biolab’s founder and chief scientist, indeed developed a groundbreaking Augmentation Gel therapy. But here’s the catch, Wingstitch has his own vision of perfection. As a result, countless misguided reptiles and amphibians who entered his clinic are doomed to stay there forever as perfect but willless test subjects. Their only task is to guard the laboratory's most valuable asset and a crucial component of the Augmentation Gel: the blood of a perfect mythological beast, the Ancient Tiger.

Biolab’s environments may seem sterile, but don’t get fooled; prepare for a serious biohazard threat once you enter. Keep away from plants and your own shortcomings at all times!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/e8e53a14409a0eae7861493e0d78113043e450c0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Enemies: WHEN MYSTERIOUS GEL MEETS DINOSAUR DESCENDANTS
[/h3]

The Augmentation Gel is truly a magnificent invention. Thanks to the addition of the Ancient Tiger's blood, it has the power to erase all flaws and imperfections. Or maybe all it does is boost one's confidence so much that they no longer consider themselves flawed? Whatever it is, it surely did a good job on Biolab's amphibians and reptiles, bringing their species close to the might their dinosaur relatives once had. 

Prepare to face crocodiles with elongated limbs and tortoises so swift they become ninjas. Beware of chunky toads (who were already perfect - but everything can be made even better by giving it a rocket launcher, right?). Keep an eye out for chameleons with improved sight. Oh, and don't underestimate the staff of axolotl doctors; they were specifically trained to spot all deficiencies in their subjects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/a3131ad6705d93f84141429d75e9154e156f47c9.jpg[/img]

[h3]THE ROBOT FIGHT: GEL-A-TRON, THE (UN)HELPFUL ASSISTANT[/h3]

Gel-A-Tron is an assistive robot and Wingstitch Spitfire's right hand... or left, or a foot, or a screwdriver, or whatever is really needed at the time. Gel-A-Tron not only provides the substance during medical procedures but also embodies it as the very essence of its being. Being made out of gel, all Gel-A-Tron talks about is gel, and it fights with… you guessed it, gel.

When threatened, Gel-A-Tron will enter a battle stance, using ranged and melee weapons or creating protective barriers. It can also undergo a Bio Mitosis process, separating a portion of gel that makes up its body to become its ally in battle - Mr. Slime. As if that was not enough, Gel-A-Tron's office itself is a trap, as he can trigger a complete disinfection process within, eradicating any organic matter deemed ‘waste’. This fight will be a sticky situation to deal with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/79f1fef297ed7dbdb3e530c59e0a95564ee63b19.jpg[/img]
"Gel is life. Gel is death. Gel is all."—Gel-A-Tron

[h3]THE DINOSAUR FIGHT: WINGSTITCH SPITFIRE, THE CRAZY SCIENTIST[/h3]

Once upon a time, a young Komodo dragon, a descendant of mighty dinosaurs, had a dream. He wished he was a mythical beast himself - a dragon. He became a scientist and developed a unique therapy that made him grow in size and physical might. Then, he implanted a pair of mechanical wings on his back and designed a fire-breathing helmet to wear. Finally, he adopted a new name: Wingstitch Spitfire, a real dragon. Astonished with his metamorphosis, he became obsessed with perfection. 

Wingstitch may seem a cold and rational scientist at first glance, but once you manage to get under his skin, prepare for quite a temper tantrum. He will unleash his fury step by step. First, prepare for a showdown of pure physical power. Then, witness the might of a dragon. Last, all hell will break loose… but let’s not spoil the surprise entirely. What is certain is that tickling the dragon’s tail can only end in two ways: you either become a legend or a roast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/48a80417dce05ca128ceb4ce9e21583cadca34d3.jpg[/img]
“The world should strive for perfection… whether it wants it or not.”—Wingstitch Spitfire

notes.title: DevLog #1
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome to Machineland, the land where all your dreams of automated warfare come true… as long as they involve mechanized rodents or marsupials! Don your safety helmet and join us on a factory tour through the first biome of Ultra Mega Cats. Here’s a taste of what our cats will face during their epic journey to restore the feline race to its former glory and become absurdly overpowered in the process.[/h3]

[b]THE MACHINELAND FACILITY[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/eae968de1961c6ae2cc9faa3d77589f7db192873.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/a37ce345607de98528a6c032b3c29f400dfb03dd.jpg[/img]

Machineland is a famous arms corporation that specializes in the commercial supply of mechanized rodents and marsupials. Its founder, Theodore — a giant bear, vicious industrialist, and a wannabe general, had an ingenious business idea: why strain budgets by funding soldiers and weapons separately when you could convert soldiers INTO weapons? That's precisely what he did, using the power of the Ancient Lion, whom he captured. We’ll delve into the details later, but one thing is certain; having the power of a feline god of strength at your disposal works magic for the company's revenue.

Upon entering the company premises the Ultra Mega Cats will trigger an immediate alarm and summon endless waves of enemies. Climbing the corporate ladder to reach the upper management levels, where the Ancient Lion is imprisoned, is no small feat! 

[b]A FAMILY OF FURY FOES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/f8fa0697ee78cf7ac9f2317e5cbc74cf333a79f9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/ae6123794cb215acc1fb17e61b63f2f559d265af.jpg[/img]

Machineland’s trade secret is the rodent and marsupial mechanization process. The technique here is simple; take a hair from the divine Lion’s mane, add a battalion of minor fur animals, and a crate of combat equipment, put them together, maybe shake a little, and voilà—a fresh batch of weaponized soldiers is ready for action. Hamster Bombs? Check! Roborabbits? Confirmed. Automated Rats? For sure! Ferret Turrets? You bet. Beaver Saws? Absolutely! All fearless and eager to fight. 

However, beware of any contamination. A single misplaced shopping cart or a forgotten set of ballet equipment can lead to some... unusual results. When you see those Beaver Shooters or Koala Ballerinas, you'll know. But don't underestimate these products of mishaps—they are as lethal as the rest of Machineland’s commercial army.

To sum up: brace yourself to face dozens of killer rabbits (like the ones from Monty Python) and other deadly creatures at once!


[b]ELUSIVE MINIBOSS: RAT KING[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/e19b6b3b47771970d343a3ba73b292e90a1fa0a5.png[/img]

The Rat King rules over the forgotten bottom level of the Machineland, a dump yard called the Thrash Emporium. All the rats aboard the space factory, even those in Theodore’s army, obey the Rat King’s orders. The Rat King believes rats will outlive all other races and inherit the universe one day. So, the King patiently waits for that moment to come, feeding on scraps and scheming in hiding, surrounded by fumes of garbage and madness.

The Rat King is always accompanied by a swarm of rats, which it can use to attack its enemy, heal itself, or … create a giant hammer out of them. Watch for its cloak too, who knows what hides underneath. Oh, rats, it’s going to be a tough fight!

“[i]Cornered rat will bite the cat![/i]”—Rat King.


[b]THE BOSS BEAR: THEODORE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811872/e44da914f3781344bfa7bc44de1fa39b44cf082f.png[/img]

The infamous phrase “the boss wants to see you”' just got even more disturbing. Get ready for a tough business with this boss encounter!

Theodore, the bear, is a ruthless, greedy, exploitative capitalist. He began his career manufacturing buttons and zippers, quickly amassing a fortune. However, his resentment for buttons ran deep. He felt they wielded too much control over him. Craving dominion rather than submission, he dreamt of commanding an army. So, he pivoted his enterprise towards warfare and declared himself the 'Boss General,' 'Warfare Kingpin,' 'Chief Everything Officer,' and 'Machines Overlord,' among other grandiose titles.

Dressed in a suit that mimics a military uniform, complete with medals he has self-bestowed, Theodore wields a rocket launcher suitcase, for you know, heated negotiations. Another asset to beware of is … Theodore’s butt. You may laugh now, but just wait and see the shockwave he can generate just by dropping on it. And, of course, he's never without his legions, always ready at his beck and call. Think carefully if you really want to battle Theodore—you might just get fired!

“[i]Have you come to a job interview, little cat? Let me see your qualifications![/i]”—Boss Bear Theodore.


That's all for now but stay tuned for another devlog and join our [url=https://discord.gg/wgeGMj26pg]Discord[/url] to discuss the game with our community!
